57	def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
58	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
59	    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
60	    with temporary.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
61	        json.dump(value, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
62	        handle.write("\n")
63	    temporary.replace(path)

154	        raise ValueError(f"unexpected shard plan schema {plan.get('schema')!r}")

163	    if not isinstance(plan_packages, list):
164	        failures.append("plan packages are not a list")
165	        plan_packages = []
166	    normalized_plan_packages: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
167	    for item in plan_packages:
168	        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("importPath"), str):
169	            failures.append("plan contains a malformed package entry")
170	            continue

172	        if package in normalized_plan_packages:
173	            failures.append(f"plan declares package {package} more than once")
174	        normalized_plan_packages[package] = item
175	    if set(normalized_plan_packages) != set(inventory_by_package):
176	        failures.append("plan package set differs from compiled inventories")
177	    for package in sorted(set(normalized_plan_packages) & set(inventory_by_package)):
178	        planned, inventory = normalized_plan_packages[package], inventory_by_package[package]
179	        for key in (
180	            "packageDirectoryRelative",
181	            "binaryName",
182	            "binarySha256",
183	            "binarySizeBytes",
184	            "testMainDeclarations",
185	        ):
186	            if planned.get(key) != inventory.get(key):
187	                failures.append(f"plan {package} {key} differs from compiled inventory")
188	        if planned.get("rootCount") != len(inventory["roots"]):
189	            failures.append(f"plan {package} root count differs from compiled inventory")
190	
191	    shards = plan.get("shards")
192	    shard_count = plan.get("shardCount")
193	    if (
194	        not isinstance(shard_count, int)
195	        or isinstance(shard_count, bool)
196	        or not isinstance(shards, list)
197	        or len(shards) != shard_count
198	    ):

200	        shards = []
201	    assignment_for_root: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
202	    process_assignments: dict[tuple[int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
203	    duplicate_roots: list[str] = []
204	    regex_mismatches: list[str] = []
205	    for position, shard in enumerate(shards):
206	        if not isinstance(shard, dict) or shard.get("index") != position:
207	            failures.append(f"plan shard at position {position} has a mismatched index")
208	            continue
209	        assignments = shard.get("assignments")
210	        if not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments:
211	            failures.append(f"plan shard {position} has no assignments")
212	            continue
213	        seen_packages: set[str] = set()
214	        counted_roots = 0
215	        for assignment in assignments:
216	            if not isinstance(assignment, dict):
217	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} contains a malformed assignment")
218	                continue
219	            package = assignment.get("importPath")
220	            if not isinstance(package, str) or package not in inventory_by_package:
221	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} references unknown package {package!r}")
222	                continue
223	            if package in seen_packages:
224	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} assigns package {package} more than once")
225	            seen_packages.add(package)
226	            process_assignments[(position, package)] = assignment
227	            inventory = inventory_by_package[package]
228	            for key in ("packageDirectoryRelative", "binaryName", "binarySha256"):
229	                if assignment.get(key) != inventory.get(key):
230	                    failures.append(f"plan shard {position} {package} {key} differs from inventory")
231	            roots = assignment.get("roots")
232	            expression = assignment.get("runRegex")
233	            if not isinstance(roots, list) or not roots or not isinstance(expression, str):
234	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} {package} has malformed roots or regex")
235	                continue
236	            names: list[str] = []
237	            for root in roots:
238	                name = root.get("name") if isinstance(root, dict) else None
239	                kind = root.get("kind") if isinstance(root, dict) else None
240	                if (
241	                    not isinstance(name, str)
242	                    or name not in root_details[package]
243	                    or kind != root_details[package].get(name)
244	                ):
245	                    failures.append(f"plan shard {position} {package} contains an unknown root")
246	                    continue
247	                key = (package, name)
248	                if key in assignment_for_root:
249	                    duplicate_roots.append(f"{package}::{name}")
250	                assignment_for_root[key] = position
251	                names.append(name)
252	            counted_roots += len(names)
253	            if len(names) != len(set(names)):
254	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} {package} repeats a root")
255	            try:
256	                compiled = re.compile(expression)
257	            except re.error as error:
258	                failures.append(f"plan shard {position} {package} has invalid regex: {error}")
259	                continue
260	            selected = {name for name in root_details[package] if compiled.fullmatch(name)}
261	            if selected != set(names):
262	                regex_mismatches.append(f"shard {position} {package}")
263	        if shard.get("rootCount") != counted_roots:
264	            failures.append(f"plan shard {position} rootCount differs from assignments")
265	    expected_roots = {
266	        (package, name) for package, names in root_details.items() for name in names
267	    }
268	    missing_roots = expected_roots - set(assignment_for_root)
269	    unexpected_roots = set(assignment_for_root) - expected_roots
270	    if missing_roots:
271	        failures.append(f"plan omits {len(missing_roots)} compiled runnable roots")
272	    if unexpected_roots:
273	        failures.append(f"plan adds {len(unexpected_roots)} unknown runnable roots")
274	    if duplicate_roots:
275	        failures.append(f"plan assigns {len(duplicate_roots)} runnable roots more than once")
276	    if regex_mismatches:
277	        failures.append(f"{len(regex_mismatches)} plan regexes select a different root set")
278	    if plan.get("rootCount") != len(expected_roots):
279	        failures.append("plan rootCount differs from compiled inventories")
280	    return assignment_for_root, process_assignments, root_details

594	                and event["ImportPath"]
595	                and isinstance(event.get("Output"), str)
596	            ):
597	                build_output_count += 1
598	                continue
599	            failures.append("non-heavy stream contains an event without Action or Package")
600	            continue
601	        if package not in expected_packages:
602	            unexpected_packages.add(package)
603	            continue
604	        test = event.get("Test")
605	        if test is None:
606	            if action == "start":
607	                starts[package] += 1
608	            elif action in TERMINAL_ACTIONS:
609	                terminals[(package, action)] += 1
610	                if action == "fail":
611	                    failures.append(f"non-heavy package {package} failed")
612	        elif isinstance(test, str):
613	            root = test.split("/", 1)[0]
614	            if root.startswith("Benchmark") and action in {"run", *TERMINAL_ACTIONS}:
615	                benchmark_roots.add(f"{package}::{root}")
616	            if action == "fail":
617	                failed_tests.add(f"{package}::{test}")
618	        else:
619	            failures.append("non-heavy stream contains a malformed Test field")
620	    if unexpected_packages:
621	        failures.append(f"non-heavy stream emitted {len(unexpected_packages)} unexpected packages")
622	    if benchmark_roots:
623	        failures.append(f"non-heavy default invocation ran {len(benchmark_roots)} benchmarks")
624	    if failed_tests:
625	        failures.append(f"non-heavy stream contains {len(failed_tests)} failed test events")
626	    package_mismatches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
627	    for package in expected_packages:
628	        counts = {action: terminals[(package, action)] for action in sorted(TERMINAL_ACTIONS)}
629	        if starts[package] != 1 or sum(counts.values()) != 1 or counts["fail"] != 0:
630	            package_mismatches.append(
631	                {"package": package, "startCount": starts[package], "terminalCounts": counts}
632	            )
633	    if package_mismatches:
634	        failures.append(f"{len(package_mismatches)} non-heavy packages lack exactly one start and successful terminal")
635	    return {
636	        "eventCount": len(events),
637	        "buildOutputCount": build_output_count,
638	        "expectedPackageCount": len(expected_packages),
639	        "unexpectedPackages": sorted(unexpected_packages),
640	        "benchmarkRoots": sorted(benchmark_roots),
641	        "failedTests": sorted(failed_tests)[:100],
642	        "packageMismatches": package_mismatches[:100],
643	        "differencesTruncated": len(failed_tests) > 100 or len(package_mismatches) > 100,
644	    }

649	    exit_report: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
650	    report: dict[str, Any] = {
651	        "schema": REPORT_SCHEMA,
652	        "passed": False,
653	        "failures": failures,
654	    }
655	    target = targets.resolve(getattr(args, "target", targets.DEFAULT.name))
656	    bundle = args.bundle.resolve(strict=True)

658	    package_path = bundle / "package-inventory.json"
659	    prepare_path = bundle / "prepare-metadata.json"
660	    settings_path = bundle / "settings.json"
661	    weights_path = bundle / "historical-weights.json"
662	    inventory_paths = sorted((bundle / "inventories").glob("*.inventory.json"))
663	    if not inventory_paths:
664	        raise ValueError("bundle contains no compiled inventories")
665	    inventories = plan_shards.load_inventories(inventory_paths, target)
666	    plan = read_json(plan_path)
667	    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
668	        raise ValueError("plan is not an object")
669	    settings = plan_shards.load_settings(settings_path)
670	    if plan_shards.settings_target(settings) is not target:
671	        failures.append(f"bundled settings target is not exactly {target.description}")
672	    if plan.get("shardCount") != settings.get("shardCount"):
673	        failures.append("bundled settings shard count differs from plan")
674	    for key in (
675	        "timeout",
676	        "commandLineLimit",
677	        "shuffle",
678	        "testParallel",
679	        "goMaxProcs",
680	        "defaultWeightSeconds",
681	    ):
682	        if plan.get("settings", {}).get(key) != settings.get(key):
683	            failures.append(f"bundled setting {key} differs from plan")
684	    if plan.get("historicalWeights", {}).get("sha256") != plan_shards.sha256_file(weights_path):
685	        failures.append("bundled historical-weight hash differs from plan")
686	
687	    prepare = read_json(prepare_path)
688	    if not isinstance(prepare, dict) or prepare.get("schema") != PREPARE_SCHEMA:
689	        failures.append("unexpected prepare metadata schema")
690	    else:
691	        verify_prepare_operation_exits(
692	            prepare,
693	            {inventory["importPath"] for inventory in inventories},
694	            str(prepare_path),
695	            failures,
696	            exit_report,
697	        )
698	        if prepare.get("repositorySha") != plan.get("repositorySha"):
699	            failures.append("prepare repository SHA differs from plan")
700	        if prepare.get("repositoryShaAfter") != plan.get("repositorySha"):
701	            failures.append("prepare post-run repository SHA differs from plan")
702	        if prepare.get("goVersion") != plan.get("goVersion"):
703	            failures.append("prepare Go version differs from plan")
704	        if prepare.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment:
705	            failures.append(f"prepare target is not exactly {target.description}")
706	        if prepare.get("targetEnvironment") != plan.get("targetEnvironment"):
707	            failures.append("prepare target differs from plan")
708	        if prepare.get("trackedWorktreeCleanBefore") is not True:
709	            failures.append("prepare did not prove a clean tracked worktree before execution")
710	        if prepare.get("trackedWorktreeCleanAfter") is not True:
711	            failures.append("prepare did not prove a clean tracked worktree after execution")
712	        if not isinstance(prepare.get("goToolDirectory"), str) or not prepare["goToolDirectory"]:
713	            failures.append("prepare omitted its resolved Go tool directory")
714	
715	    for inventory in inventories:
716	        binary = bundle / "binaries" / inventory["binaryName"]
717	        if not binary.is_file():
718	            failures.append(f"compiled binary is missing: {inventory['binaryName']}")
719	            continue
720	        if binary.stat().st_size != inventory["binarySizeBytes"]:
721	            failures.append(f"compiled binary size differs from inventory: {inventory['binaryName']}")
722	        if plan_shards.sha256_file(binary) != inventory["binarySha256"]:
723	            failures.append(f"compiled binary hash differs from inventory: {inventory['binaryName']}")
724	
725	    assignment_for_root, process_assignments, root_details = validate_plan(
726	        plan, inventories, failures, target
727	    )
728	    package_inventory = read_json(package_path)
729	    if not isinstance(package_inventory, dict) or package_inventory.get("schema") != PACKAGE_SCHEMA:
730	        raise ValueError(f"unexpected target-{target.host_label} package inventory schema")
731	    if package_inventory.get("repositorySha") != plan.get("repositorySha"):
732	        failures.append("package inventory repository SHA differs from plan")
733	    if package_inventory.get("goVersion") != plan.get("goVersion"):
734	        failures.append("package inventory Go version differs from plan")
735	    package_target = {
736	        "GOOS": package_inventory.get("goos"),
737	        "GOARCH": package_inventory.get("goarch"),
738	        "CGO_ENABLED": package_inventory.get("cgoEnabled"),
739	    }
740	    if package_target != target.environment:
741	        failures.append(f"package inventory target is not exactly {target.description}")
742	    if package_target != plan.get("targetEnvironment"):
743	        failures.append("package inventory target differs from plan")
744	    package_rows = package_inventory.get("packages")
745	    if not isinstance(package_rows, list) or not package_rows:
746	        raise ValueError(f"target-{target.host_label} package inventory is empty")
747	    package_names: set[str] = set()
748	    heavy_names: set[str] = set()
749	    for row in package_rows:
750	        if not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(row.get("heavy"), bool):
751	            raise ValueError(
752	                f"target-{target.host_label} package inventory contains a malformed row"
753	            )
754	        package = row.get("importPath")
755	        if not isinstance(package, str) or not package or package in package_names:
756	            raise ValueError(
757	                f"target-{target.host_label} package inventory contains a missing or duplicate package"
758	            )
759	        package_names.add(package)
760	        if row["heavy"]:
761	            heavy_names.add(package)
762	    if heavy_names != set(root_details):
763	        failures.append(
764	            f"target-{target.host_label} heavy package declarations differ from compiled inventories"
765	        )
766	    configured_test_mains = {
767	        item["importPath"]: item["expectedTestMainDeclarations"]
768	        for item in settings["heavyPackages"]
769	    }
770	    inventory_test_mains = {
771	        item["importPath"]: item["testMainDeclarations"] for item in inventories
772	    }
773	    if configured_test_mains != inventory_test_mains:
774	        failures.append("compiled TestMain declarations differ from bundled settings")
775	
776	    report["shards"] = verify_shards(
777	        args.shard_results.resolve(strict=True),
778	        plan,
779	        plan_shards.sha256_file(plan_path),
780	        inventories,
781	        assignment_for_root,
782	        process_assignments,
783	        root_details,
784	        failures,
785	        exit_report,
786	        target,
787	    )
788	    report["otherPackages"] = verify_other(
789	        args.other_results.resolve(strict=True),
790	        plan,
791	        plan_shards.sha256_file(plan_path),
792	        package_inventory,
793	        plan_shards.sha256_file(package_path),
794	        failures,
795	        exit_report,
796	        target,
797	    )
798	    report["inventory"] = {
799	        "repositorySha": plan.get("repositorySha"),
800	        "goVersion": plan.get("goVersion"),
801	        "targetEnvironment": plan.get("targetEnvironment"),
802	        "packageCount": len(package_names),
803	        "heavyPackageCount": len(heavy_names),
804	        "runnableRootCount": len(assignment_for_root),
805	        "excludedBenchmarkCount": sum(len(item["excludedBenchmarks"]) for item in inventories),
806	        "historicallyWeightedCount": plan.get("historicalWeights", {}).get("usedCount"),
807	        "defaultWeightedCount": plan.get("historicalWeights", {}).get("defaultedCount"),
808	    }
809	    report["exitCodes"] = exit_report
810	    report["passed"] = not failures
811	    return report

814	def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
815	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
816	    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, required=True)
817	    parser.add_argument("--shard-results", type=Path, required=True)
818	    parser.add_argument("--other-results", type=Path, required=True)
819	    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
820	    parser.add_argument("--target", default=targets.DEFAULT.name, choices=sorted(targets.TARGETS))
821	    return parser.parse_args(argv)

824	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
825	    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
826	    try:
827	        report = verify(args)
828	    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
829	        report = {"schema": REPORT_SCHEMA, "passed": False, "failures": [str(error)]}
830	    try:
831	        write_json(args.output, report)
832	    except OSError as error:
833	        print(f"error: cannot write report {args.output}: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
834	        return 2
835	    if not report.get("passed"):
836	        for failure in report.get("failures", []):
837	            print(f"FAIL: {failure}", file=sys.stderr)
838	        return 1
839	    print(
840	        f"{targets.resolve(args.target).host_label} shard coverage and integrity verification passed"
841	    )
842	    return 0

38	def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
39	    try:
40	        with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
41	            return json.load(handle)
42	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
43	        raise ValueError(f"cannot read JSON {path}: {error}") from error

46	def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
47	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
48	    try:
49	        with path.open("rb") as handle:
50	            for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
51	                digest.update(chunk)
52	    except OSError as error:
53	        raise ValueError(f"cannot hash {path}: {error}") from error
54	    return digest.hexdigest()

57	def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
58	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
59	    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
60	    with temporary.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
61	        json.dump(value, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
62	        handle.write("\n")
63	    temporary.replace(path)

66	def _safe_relative_directory(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
67	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\\" in value:

69	    path = PurePosixPath(value)
70	    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or "." in path.parts:
71	        raise ValueError(f"{label} is unsafe: {value!r}")
72	    return value

75	def load_settings(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
76	    value = read_json(path)
77	    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != SETTINGS_SCHEMA:
78	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: unexpected settings schema")
79	    target = settings_target(value)
80	    shard_count = value.get("shardCount")
81	    default_weight = value.get("defaultWeightSeconds")
82	    command_limit = value.get("commandLineLimit")
83	    timeout = value.get("timeout")
84	    if not isinstance(shard_count, int) or isinstance(shard_count, bool) or not 1 <= shard_count <= 64:
85	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: shardCount must be an integer from 1 through 64")
86	    if (
87	        not isinstance(default_weight, (int, float))
88	        or isinstance(default_weight, bool)
89	        or not math.isfinite(float(default_weight))
90	        or float(default_weight) <= 0
91	    ):
92	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: defaultWeightSeconds must be finite and positive")
93	    if not target.valid_command_line_limit(command_limit):
94	        raise ValueError(
95	            f"{path}: commandLineLimit must be from 1024 through {target.command_line_limit_maximum}"
96	        )
97	    if not isinstance(timeout, str) or not _TIMEOUT.fullmatch(timeout):
98	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: timeout is not a positive Go duration")
99	    if value.get("shuffle") != "off":
100	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: production sharding currently requires shuffle='off'")
101	    for name in ("testParallel", "goMaxProcs"):
102	        setting = value.get(name)
103	        if setting is not None and (
104	            not isinstance(setting, int) or isinstance(setting, bool) or not 1 <= setting <= 1024
105	        ):
106	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: {name} must be null or an integer from 1 through 1024")
107	
108	    heavy = value.get("heavyPackages")
109	    if not isinstance(heavy, list) or not heavy:
110	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: heavyPackages must be a non-empty list")
111	    seen_arguments: set[str] = set()
112	    seen_imports: set[str] = set()
113	    seen_binaries: set[str] = set()
114	    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
115	    for position, item in enumerate(heavy):
116	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
117	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: heavyPackages[{position}] is not an object")
118	        argument = item.get("argument")
119	        import_path = item.get("importPath")
120	        binary_name = item.get("binaryName")
121	        expected_test_mains = item.get("expectedTestMainDeclarations")
122	        if not isinstance(argument, str) or not argument.startswith("./") or " " in argument:
123	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsafe heavy package argument {argument!r}")
124	        if not isinstance(import_path, str) or not import_path or any(c.isspace() for c in import_path):
125	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsafe heavy package importPath {import_path!r}")
126	        if (
127	            not isinstance(binary_name, str)

129	            or "/" in binary_name

132	        ):

134	        if argument in seen_arguments or import_path in seen_imports or binary_name in seen_binaries:
135	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: duplicate heavy package field at index {position}")
136	        if not isinstance(expected_test_mains, list):
137	            raise ValueError(
138	                f"{path}: heavyPackages[{position}].expectedTestMainDeclarations must be a list"
139	            )
140	        normalized_test_mains: list[dict[str, str]] = []
141	        seen_test_main_files: set[str] = set()
142	        for declaration_position, declaration in enumerate(expected_test_mains):
143	            if not isinstance(declaration, dict):
144	                raise ValueError(
145	                    f"{path}: heavyPackages[{position}].expectedTestMainDeclarations[{declaration_position}] is not an object"
146	                )
147	            file_name = declaration.get("file")
148	            source_hash = declaration.get("normalizedSourceSha256")
149	            if (
150	                not isinstance(file_name, str)
151	                or not file_name
152	                or Path(file_name).name != file_name
153	                or "/" in file_name
154	                or "\\" in file_name
155	                or file_name in seen_test_main_files
156	            ):
157	                raise ValueError(
158	                    f"{path}: invalid or duplicate expected TestMain file {file_name!r}"
159	                )
160	            if not isinstance(source_hash, str) or not _SHA256.fullmatch(source_hash):
161	                raise ValueError(
162	                    f"{path}: invalid expected TestMain normalized source hash for {file_name!r}"
163	                )
164	            seen_test_main_files.add(file_name)
165	            normalized_test_mains.append(
166	                {"file": file_name, "normalizedSourceSha256": source_hash}
167	            )

188	class Weights(dict):
189	    """Per-root elapsed seconds, plus what is known about `t.Parallel()` roots.
190	
191	    `parallel` names the roots that call `t.Parallel()`; `parallelism` is how
192	    many of them effectively run at once on the target's runner. A plain dict
193	    carries neither, which plans every root as serial.
194	    """
195	
196	    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
197	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
198	        self.parallel: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
199	        self.parallelism = 1.0
200	
201	
202	def process_seconds(serial: float, parallel: float, longest_parallel: float, parallelism: float) -> float:
203	    """Estimated wall time of one test process.
204	
205	    `go test` runs a binary's serial roots first, one at a time, and then its
206	    `t.Parallel()` roots together. The parallel phase can end no sooner than
207	    its longest root and no sooner than its total work spread over the cores.
208	    """
209	    return serial + max(longest_parallel, parallel / parallelism)
210	
211	
212	def load_weights(path: Path) -> tuple[Weights, dict[str, Any]]:
213	    value = read_json(path)
214	    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != WEIGHTS_SCHEMA:
215	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: unexpected historical-weight schema")
216	    rows = value.get("weights")
217	    if not isinstance(rows, list):
218	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: weights must be a list")
219	    parallelism = value.get("parallelism", 1.0)
220	    if (
221	        not isinstance(parallelism, (int, float))
222	        or isinstance(parallelism, bool)
223	        or not math.isfinite(float(parallelism))
224	        or not 1.0 <= float(parallelism) <= 1024.0
225	    ):
226	        raise ValueError(f"{path}: parallelism must be from 1 through 1024")
227	    weights = Weights()
228	    weights.parallelism = float(parallelism)
229	    for position, row in enumerate(rows):
230	        if not isinstance(row, dict):
231	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: weights[{position}] is not an object")
232	        package, name, seconds = row.get("package"), row.get("name"), row.get("seconds")
233	        if not isinstance(package, str) or not package or not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
234	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: weights[{position}] has an invalid key")
235	        if (
236	            not isinstance(seconds, (int, float))
237	            or isinstance(seconds, bool)
238	            or not math.isfinite(float(seconds))
239	            or float(seconds) < 0
240	        ):
241	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: weights[{position}] seconds must be finite and non-negative")
242	        key = (package, name)
243	        if key in weights:
244	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: duplicate weight for {package}::{name}")
245	        parallel = row.get("parallel", False)
246	        if not isinstance(parallel, bool):
247	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: weights[{position}] parallel must be a boolean")
248	        weights[key] = float(seconds)
249	        if parallel:
250	            weights.parallel.add(key)
251	    metadata = {
252	        "path": path.name,
253	        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
254	        "sourceCommit": value.get("sourceCommit"),
255	        "source": value.get("source"),
256	        "entryCount": len(weights),
257	        "parallelism": weights.parallelism,
258	        "parallelCount": len(weights.parallel),
259	    }
260	    return weights, metadata

269	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
270	    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
271	    seen_packages: set[str] = set()
272	    for path in paths:
273	        value = read_json(path)
274	        if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != INVENTORY_SCHEMA:
275	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unexpected compiled-inventory schema")
276	        package = value.get("importPath")
277	        binary = value.get("binaryName")
278	        roots = value.get("roots")
279	        if not isinstance(package, str) or not package or package in seen_packages:
280	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: missing or duplicate importPath")
281	        if (
282	            not isinstance(binary, str)
283	            or Path(binary).name != binary
284	            or "/" in binary
285	            or "\\" in binary
286	            or not binary.endswith(target.binary_suffix)
287	        ):
288	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsafe binaryName")
289	        if value.get("listExitCode") != 0:
290	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: compiled binary listing did not exit zero")
291	        if not isinstance(value.get("repositorySha"), str) or not _SHA.fullmatch(value["repositorySha"]):
292	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid repositorySha")
293	        if not isinstance(value.get("goVersion"), str) or not value["goVersion"].startswith("go version go"):
294	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid goVersion")
295	        if not isinstance(value.get("binarySha256"), str) or not _SHA256.fullmatch(value["binarySha256"]):
296	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid binarySha256")
297	        if not isinstance(value.get("binarySizeBytes"), int) or value["binarySizeBytes"] <= 0:
298	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid binarySizeBytes")
299	        target_environment = {
300	            "GOOS": value.get("goos"),
301	            "GOARCH": value.get("goarch"),
302	            "CGO_ENABLED": value.get("cgoEnabled"),
303	        }
304	        if target_environment != target.environment:
305	            raise ValueError(
306	                f"{path}: compiled inventory target is {target_environment!r}, want {target.environment!r}"
307	            )
308	        listing_contract = value.get("listingContract")
309	        if listing_contract != {
310	            "arguments": ["-test.paniconexit0", "-test.list=."],
311	            "paniconexit0": True,
312	            "pwdMatchesPackageDirectory": True,
313	            "goToolDirectoryPrependedToPath": True,
314	        }:
315	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: direct binary listing contract is missing or unexpected")
316	        relative = _safe_relative_directory(
317	            value.get("packageDirectoryRelative"), f"{path}: packageDirectoryRelative"
318	        )
319	        if not isinstance(roots, list) or not roots:
320	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: roots must be a non-empty list")
321	        names: set[str] = set()
322	        normalized_roots: list[dict[str, str]] = []
323	        for position, root in enumerate(roots):
324	            if not isinstance(root, dict):
325	                raise ValueError(f"{path}: roots[{position}] is not an object")
326	            name, kind = root.get("name"), root.get("kind")
327	            if (
328	                not isinstance(name, str)
329	                or not name
330	                or any(character.isspace() for character in name)
331	                or kind not in ROOT_KINDS
332	                or _root_kind(name) != kind
333	                or name in names
334	            ):
335	                raise ValueError(f"{path}: malformed or duplicate runnable root at index {position}")
336	            names.add(name)
337	            normalized_roots.append({"name": name, "kind": kind})
338	        benchmarks = value.get("excludedBenchmarks")
339	        if (
340	            not isinstance(benchmarks, list)
341	            or any(not isinstance(name, str) or not name.startswith("Benchmark") for name in benchmarks)
342	            or len(benchmarks) != len(set(benchmarks))
343	        ):
344	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: excludedBenchmarks must contain unique Benchmark names")
345	        test_main_declarations = value.get("testMainDeclarations")
346	        if not isinstance(test_main_declarations, list):
347	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: testMainDeclarations must be a list")
348	        normalized_test_mains: list[dict[str, str]] = []
349	        seen_test_main_files: set[str] = set()
350	        for position, declaration in enumerate(test_main_declarations):
351	            if not isinstance(declaration, dict):
352	                raise ValueError(f"{path}: testMainDeclarations[{position}] is not an object")
353	            file_name = declaration.get("file")
354	            source_hash = declaration.get("normalizedSourceSha256")
355	            if (
356	                not isinstance(file_name, str)
357	                or not file_name
358	                or Path(file_name).name != file_name
359	                or "/" in file_name
360	                or "\\" in file_name
361	                or file_name in seen_test_main_files
362	            ):
363	                raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid or duplicate TestMain file {file_name!r}")
364	            if not isinstance(source_hash, str) or not _SHA256.fullmatch(source_hash):
365	                raise ValueError(f"{path}: invalid TestMain normalized source hash for {file_name!r}")
366	            seen_test_main_files.add(file_name)
367	            normalized_test_mains.append(
368	                {"file": file_name, "normalizedSourceSha256": source_hash}
369	            )
370	        seen_packages.add(package)
371	        result.append(
372	            {
373	                "importPath": package,
374	                "packageArgument": value.get("packageArgument"),
375	                "packageDirectoryRelative": relative,
376	                "binaryName": binary,
377	                "binarySha256": value["binarySha256"],
378	                "binarySizeBytes": value["binarySizeBytes"],
379	                "repositorySha": value["repositorySha"],
380	                "goVersion": value["goVersion"],
381	                "targetEnvironment": {
382	                    key: target.environment[key] for key in ("GOOS", "GOARCH", "CGO_ENABLED")
383	                },
384	                "listingContract": dict(listing_contract),
385	                "roots": sorted(normalized_roots, key=lambda item: item["name"]),
386	                "excludedBenchmarks": sorted(benchmarks),
387	                "testMainDeclarations": sorted(
388	                    normalized_test_mains, key=lambda declaration: declaration["file"]
389	                ),

395	class _Trie:
396	    __slots__ = ("children", "terminal")
397	
398	    def __init__(self) -> None:
399	        self.children: dict[str, _Trie] = {}
400	        self.terminal = False
401	
402	
403	def _render_trie(node: _Trie) -> str:
404	    alternatives = [
405	        re.escape(character) + _render_trie(child)
406	        for character, child in sorted(node.children.items())
407	    ]
408	    if not alternatives:
409	        return ""
410	    body = alternatives[0] if len(alternatives) == 1 else "(" + "|".join(alternatives) + ")"
411	    return "(" + body + ")?" if node.terminal else body

414	def compressed_run_regex(names: Iterable[str]) -> str:
415	    ordered = sorted(set(names))
416	    if not ordered:
417	        raise ValueError("cannot create a run regex for no roots")
418	    root = _Trie()
419	    for name in ordered:
420	        node = root
421	        for character in name:
422	            node = node.children.setdefault(character, _Trie())
423	        node.terminal = True
424	    return "^" + _render_trie(root) + "$"

430	    ).encode("utf-8")

434	def create_plan(
435	    inventories: list[dict[str, Any]],
436	    settings: dict[str, Any],
437	    weights: dict[tuple[str, str], float],
438	    weight_metadata: dict[str, Any],
439	) -> dict[str, Any]:
440	    if not inventories:
441	        raise ValueError("at least one compiled inventory is required")
442	    target = settings_target(settings)
443	    if any(item.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment for item in inventories):
444	        raise ValueError(f"compiled inventories are not all {target.description}")
445	    expected_config = {
446	        (item["importPath"], item["binaryName"])
447	        for item in settings["heavyPackages"]
448	    }
449	    actual_config = {(item["importPath"], item["binaryName"]) for item in inventories}
450	    if actual_config != expected_config:
451	        raise ValueError("compiled inventories do not exactly match configured heavy packages")
452	    expected_test_mains = {
453	        item["importPath"]: item["expectedTestMainDeclarations"]
454	        for item in settings["heavyPackages"]
455	    }
456	    for inventory in inventories:
457	        if inventory["testMainDeclarations"] != expected_test_mains[inventory["importPath"]]:
458	            raise ValueError(
459	                f"compiled TestMain declarations drifted for {inventory['importPath']}"
460	            )
461	    repository_shas = {item["repositorySha"] for item in inventories}
462	    go_versions = {item["goVersion"] for item in inventories}
463	    if len(repository_shas) != 1 or len(go_versions) != 1:
464	        raise ValueError("compiled inventories disagree on repository or Go version")
465	
466	    parallel_roots = getattr(weights, "parallel", frozenset())
467	    parallelism = float(getattr(weights, "parallelism", 1.0))
468	    work: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
469	    used_weight_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
470	    for inventory in inventories:
471	        for root in inventory["roots"]:
472	            key = (inventory["importPath"], root["name"])
473	            if key in weights:
474	                weight = weights[key]
475	                source = target.weight_source
476	                used_weight_keys.add(key)
477	            else:
478	                weight = settings["defaultWeightSeconds"]
479	                source = "default-current-inventory"
480	            work.append(
481	                {
482	                    "importPath": inventory["importPath"],
483	                    "packageDirectoryRelative": inventory["packageDirectoryRelative"],
484	                    "binaryName": inventory["binaryName"],
485	                    "binarySha256": inventory["binarySha256"],
486	                    "name": root["name"],
487	                    "kind": root["kind"],
488	                    "weightSeconds": round(float(weight), 6),
489	                    "weightSource": source,
490	                    # A root with no history is planned as serial.
491	                    "parallel": key in weights and key in parallel_roots,
492	                }
493	            )
494	
495	    shard_count = settings["shardCount"]
496	    if len(work) < shard_count:
497	        raise ValueError(f"{len(work)} runnable roots cannot populate {shard_count} non-empty shards")
498	    work.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["weightSeconds"], item["importPath"], item["name"]))
499	    bins: list[list[dict[str, Any]]] = [[] for _ in range(shard_count)]
500	    totals = [0.0] * shard_count
501	    # A shard runs one process per package, one after another, so its estimated
502	    # wall time is the sum of its processes'. Each root, slowest first, goes to
503	    # the shard that would finish soonest with it. With no parallel roots this
504	    # is longest-processing-time-first; a parallel root is free wherever it
505	    # hides beneath a longer one or beneath the cores' share of the work.
506	    processes: list[dict[str, list[float]]] = [{} for _ in range(shard_count)]
507	
508	    def placed(index: int, item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, list[float]]:
509	        serial, parallel, longest = processes[index].get(item["importPath"], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
510	        before = process_seconds(serial, parallel, longest, parallelism)
511	        if item["parallel"]:
512	            parallel += item["weightSeconds"]
513	            longest = max(longest, item["weightSeconds"])
514	        else:
515	            serial += item["weightSeconds"]
516	        after = process_seconds(serial, parallel, longest, parallelism)
517	        return totals[index] - before + after, [serial, parallel, longest]
518	
519	    for item in work:
520	        destination = min(
521	            range(shard_count),
522	            key=lambda index: (placed(index, item)[0], len(bins[index]), index),
523	        )
524	        totals[destination], processes[destination][item["importPath"]] = placed(destination, item)
525	        bins[destination].append(item)
526	
527	    shards: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
528	    for index, roots in enumerate(bins):
529	        by_package: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
530	        for root in roots:
531	            by_package[root["importPath"]].append(root)
532	        assignments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
533	        for package in sorted(by_package):
534	            package_roots = sorted(by_package[package], key=lambda item: item["name"])
535	            assignments.append(
536	                {
537	                    "importPath": package,
538	                    "packageDirectoryRelative": package_roots[0]["packageDirectoryRelative"],
539	                    "binaryName": package_roots[0]["binaryName"],
540	                    "binarySha256": package_roots[0]["binarySha256"],
541	                    "runRegex": compressed_run_regex(item["name"] for item in package_roots),
542	                    "roots": [
543	                        {
544	                            "name": item["name"],
545	                            "kind": item["kind"],
546	                            "weightSeconds": item["weightSeconds"],
547	                            "weightSource": item["weightSource"],
548	                            **({"parallel": True} if item["parallel"] else {}),
549	                        }
550	                        for item in package_roots
551	                    ],
552	                }
553	            )
554	        shards.append(
555	            {
556	                "index": index,
557	                "estimatedWeightSeconds": round(totals[index], 6),
558	                "rootCount": len(roots),
559	                "assignments": assignments,
560	            }
561	        )
562	
563	    unused = sorted(f"{package}::{name}" for package, name in set(weights) - used_weight_keys)
564	    packages = [
565	        {
566	            "importPath": item["importPath"],
567	            "packageDirectoryRelative": item["packageDirectoryRelative"],
568	            "binaryName": item["binaryName"],
569	            "binarySha256": item["binarySha256"],
570	            "binarySizeBytes": item["binarySizeBytes"],
571	            "rootCount": len(item["roots"]),
572	            "excludedBenchmarkCount": len(item["excludedBenchmarks"]),
573	            "testMainDeclarations": item["testMainDeclarations"],
574	        }
575	        for item in inventories
576	    ]
577	    return {
578	        "schema": PLAN_SCHEMA,
579	        "algorithm": "deterministic-greedy-process-wall-time-v2",
580	        "repositorySha": next(iter(repository_shas)),
581	        "goVersion": next(iter(go_versions)),
582	        "targetEnvironment": {
583	            key: target.environment[key] for key in ("GOOS", "GOARCH", "CGO_ENABLED")
584	        },
585	        "inventorySetSha256": _inventory_digest(inventories),
586	        "shardCount": shard_count,
587	        "rootCount": len(work),
588	        "packageCount": len(inventories),
589	        "settings": {
590	            "timeout": settings["timeout"],
591	            "commandLineLimit": settings["commandLineLimit"],
592	            "shuffle": settings["shuffle"],
593	            "testParallel": settings["testParallel"],
594	            "goMaxProcs": settings["goMaxProcs"],
595	            "defaultWeightSeconds": settings["defaultWeightSeconds"],
596	        },
597	        "historicalWeights": {
598	            **weight_metadata,
599	            "usedCount": len(used_weight_keys),
600	            "defaultedCount": len(work) - len(used_weight_keys),
601	            "unusedKeys": unused,
602	        },
603	        "packages": packages,
604	        "shards": shards,
605	    }

39	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
40	    with path.open("rb") as handle:

46	def decode_json_stream(value: str, label: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
47	    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
48	    position = 0
49	    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
50	    while True:
51	        match = re.search(r"\S", value[position:])
52	        if match is None:
53	            break
54	        position += match.start()
55	        try:
56	            item, position = decoder.raw_decode(value, position)
57	        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
58	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid concatenated JSON at offset {position}: {error}") from error
59	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
60	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream item is not an object")
61	        result.append(item)
62	    if not result:
63	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream is empty")
64	    return result

67	def run_command(
68	    arguments: list[str],
69	    *,
70	    cwd: Path,
71	    environment: dict[str, str],
72	    stdout_path: Path | None = None,
73	    stderr_path: Path | None = None,
74	    stdin_text: str | None = None,
75	) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], float]:
76	    started = time.monotonic()
77	    completed = subprocess.run(
78	        arguments,
79	        cwd=cwd,
80	        env=environment,
81	        text=True,
82	        encoding="utf-8",
83	        errors="strict",
84	        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
85	        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
86	        input=stdin_text,
87	        check=False,
88	    )
89	    duration = time.monotonic() - started
90	    if stdout_path is not None:
91	        write_text(stdout_path, completed.stdout)
92	    if stderr_path is not None:
93	        write_text(stderr_path, completed.stderr)
94	    return completed, duration

140	def classify_listing(lines: Iterable[str], label: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]:
141	    roots: list[dict[str, str]] = []
142	    benchmarks: list[str] = []
143	    unexpected: list[str] = []
144	    seen: set[str] = set()
145	    for raw in lines:
146	        name = raw.strip()
147	        if not name:
148	            continue
149	        if name in seen:
150	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: duplicate -test.list output {name!r}")
151	        seen.add(name)
152	        if name == "TestMain":
153	            unexpected.append(name)
154	        elif name.startswith("Benchmark"):
155	            benchmarks.append(name)
156	        else:
157	            kind = next((prefix for prefix in ROOT_PREFIXES if name.startswith(prefix)), None)
158	            if kind is None or any(character.isspace() for character in name):
159	                unexpected.append(name)
160	            else:
161	                roots.append({"name": name, "kind": kind})
162	    if unexpected:
163	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: unexpected -test.list output: {unexpected[:20]!r}")
164	    if not roots:
165	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: compiled binary listed no default-runnable roots")
166	    return sorted(roots, key=lambda item: item["name"]), sorted(benchmarks)

183	    if sys.platform != target.host_platform:
184	        raise RuntimeError(f"prepare.py must run on native {target.host_label}")

PACKAGE_SCHEMA = "entire-graph.windows-ci.package-inventory.v1"
PREPARE_SCHEMA = "entire-graph.windows-ci.prepare-metadata.v1"
ROOT_PREFIXES = ("Test", "Example", "Fuzz")
TARGET_ENVIRONMENT = targets.DEFAULT.environment
TESTMAIN_SCHEMA = "entire-graph.windows-ci.testmain-inventory.v1"


def write_text(path: Path, value: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(value, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    plan_shards.write_json(path, value)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def decode_json_stream(value: str, label: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
    position = 0
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    while True:
        match = re.search(r"\S", value[position:])
        if match is None:
            break
        position += match.start()
        try:
            item, position = decoder.raw_decode(value, position)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid concatenated JSON at offset {position}: {error}") from error
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream item is not an object")
        result.append(item)
    if not result:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream is empty")
    return result


def run_command(
    arguments: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    environment: dict[str, str],
    stdout_path: Path | None = None,
    stderr_path: Path | None = None,
    stdin_text: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], float]:
    started = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(
        arguments,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=environment,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="strict",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        input=stdin_text,
        check=False,
    )
    duration = time.monotonic() - started
    if stdout_path is not None:
        write_text(stdout_path, completed.stdout)
    if stderr_path is not None:
        write_text(stderr_path, completed.stderr)
    return completed, duration


def require_success(completed: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], label: str) -> None:
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        detail = completed.stderr.strip() or completed.stdout.strip()
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} exited {completed.returncode}: {detail[:2000]}")


def require_tracked_worktree_clean(
    completed: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], label: str
) -> None:
    require_success(completed, label)
    if completed.stdout.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}: tracked worktree modifications detected")


def direct_test_environment(
    environment: dict[str, str], package_directory: Path, go_tool_directory: Path
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not package_directory.is_absolute() or not go_tool_directory.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("direct test environment requires absolute package and Go tool directories")
    result = dict(environment)
    result["PWD"] = str(package_directory)
    existing_path = result.get("PATH", "")
    result["PATH"] = str(go_tool_directory) + (os.pathsep + existing_path if existing_path else "")
    return result


def direct_listing_arguments(binary: Path) -> list[str]:
    return [str(binary), "-test.paniconexit0", "-test.list=."]


def repository_relative_directory(repository: Path, directory: str, label: str) -> str:
    resolved = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True)
    try:
        relative = resolved.relative_to(repository)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} directory is outside the repository: {resolved}") from error
    if not relative.parts:
        return "."
    if ".." in relative.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} directory is unsafe: {relative}")
    return relative.as_posix()


def classify_listing(lines: Iterable[str], label: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]:
    roots: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    benchmarks: list[str] = []
    unexpected: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for raw in lines:
        name = raw.strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: duplicate -test.list output {name!r}")
        seen.add(name)
        if name == "TestMain":
            unexpected.append(name)
        elif name.startswith("Benchmark"):
            benchmarks.append(name)
        else:
            kind = next((prefix for prefix in ROOT_PREFIXES if name.startswith(prefix)), None)
            if kind is None or any(character.isspace() for character in name):
                unexpected.append(name)
            else:
                roots.append({"name": name, "kind": kind})
    if unexpected:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: unexpected -test.list output: {unexpected[:20]!r}")
    if not roots:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: compiled binary listed no default-runnable roots")
    return sorted(roots, key=lambda item: item["name"]), sorted(benchmarks)


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--settings", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--weights", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-repository-sha", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--go-command", default="go")
    parser.add_argument("--target", default=targets.DEFAULT.name, choices=sorted(targets.TARGETS))
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    target = targets.resolve(getattr(args, "target", targets.DEFAULT.name))
    if sys.platform != target.host_platform:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prepare.py must run on native {target.host_label}")
    repository = args.repository.resolve(strict=True)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    binaries = output / "binaries"
    inventories_dir = output / "inventories"
    logs = output / "logs"
    for directory in (binaries, inventories_dir, logs):
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    settings_path = args.settings.resolve(strict=True)
    weights_path = args.weights.resolve(strict=True)
    settings = plan_shards.load_settings(settings_path)
    if plan_shards.settings_target(settings) is not target:
        raise ValueError(
            f"settings target {settings['target']!r} differs from the requested target {target.name!r}"
        )
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", args.expected_repository_sha):
        raise ValueError("expected repository SHA must be 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters")

    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update(target.environment)
    go = shutil.which(args.go_command, path=environment.get("PATH"))
    if go is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot resolve Go command {args.go_command!r}")
    go = str(Path(go).resolve(strict=True))
    operations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    clean_before, clean_before_seconds = run_command(
        ["git", "-C", str(repository), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=no"],
        cwd=repository,
        environment=environment,
    )
    operations.append(
        {
            "phase": "worktree-clean-before",
            "exitCode": clean_before.returncode,
            "durationSeconds": round(clean_before_seconds, 6),
        }
    )
    require_tracked_worktree_clean(clean_before, "tracked worktree precondition")

    sha_process, sha_seconds = run_command(
        ["git", "-C", str(repository), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        cwd=repository,
        environment=environment,
    )
    operations.append(
        {"phase": "repository-sha", "exitCode": sha_process.returncode, "durationSeconds": round(sha_seconds, 6)}
    )
    require_success(sha_process, "git rev-parse HEAD")
    repository_sha = sha_process.stdout.strip()
    if repository_sha != args.expected_repository_sha:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"checkout SHA {repository_sha!r} does not match expected {args.expected_repository_sha!r}"
        )

    version_process, version_seconds = run_command(
        [go, "version"], cwd=repository, environment=environment
    )
    operations.append(
        {"phase": "go-version", "exitCode": version_process.returncode, "durationSeconds": round(version_seconds, 6)}
    )
    require_success(version_process, "go version")
    go_version = version_process.stdout.strip()
    env_process, env_seconds = run_command(
        [go, "env", "-json", "GOOS", "GOARCH", "CGO_ENABLED", "GOTOOLDIR"],
        cwd=repository,
        environment=environment,
    )
    operations.append(
        {"phase": "go-environment", "exitCode": env_process.returncode, "durationSeconds": round(env_seconds, 6)}
    )
    require_success(env_process, "go env")
    go_environment = json.loads(env_process.stdout)
    target_environment = {
        key: go_environment.get(key) for key in ("CGO_ENABLED", "GOARCH", "GOOS")
    }
    if target_environment != target.environment:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected target Go environment: {target_environment!r}")
    go_tool_value = go_environment.get("GOTOOLDIR")

    for item in package_objects:

                "importPath": import_path,
                "packageDirectoryRelative": repository_relative_directory(

                "heavy": import_path in configured_heavy,

        "goos": target.goos,

        "cgoEnabled": "1",

        operations.append(
            {
                "phase": "go-list-package",

        package_items = decode_json_stream(package_process.stdout, f"go list {package_argument}")

                f"{package_argument} resolved to {package_item.get('ImportPath')!r}, want {expected_import!r}"

            "exitCode": 0,
            "operations": operations,
            "packageCount": len(package_rows),
            "heavyPackageCount": len(inventory_paths),
            "rootCount": plan["rootCount"],
            "shardCount": plan["shardCount"],
        },
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        prepare(args)
    except Exception as error:  # A partial artifact must carry a machine-readable failure.
        write_json(
            output / "prepare-metadata.json",
            {
                "schema": PREPARE_SCHEMA,
                "exitCode": 2,
                "error": str(error),
            },
        )
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

168	def ensure_executable(binary: Path, target: targets.Target) -> bool:
169	    """Restore the owner execute bit that artifact transport drops on POSIX targets.
170	
171	    actions/upload-artifact stores files in a ZIP without POSIX modes, so a
172	    downloaded test binary arrives non-executable. The mode is not part of the
173	    binary's identity: the caller has already matched its SHA-256 to the plan,
174	    so setting the bit changes nothing that was verified.
175	    """

177	        return False
