def command_line_utf16_units(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> int:
    return targets.WINDOWS_AMD64.command_line_cost(executable, arguments)


def safe_repository_directory(repository: Path, relative: Any) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(relative, str) or not relative or "\\" in relative:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe package directory {relative!r}")
    value = PurePosixPath(relative)
    if value.is_absolute() or ".." in value.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"unsafe package directory {relative!r}")
    resolved = repository.joinpath(*value.parts).resolve(strict=True)
    try:
        resolved.relative_to(repository)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"package directory escaped repository: {resolved}") from error
    if not resolved.is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"package directory is not a directory: {resolved}")
    return resolved


def checked_go_version(go: str, repository: Path, environment: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [go, "version"],
        cwd=repository,
        env=environment,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="strict",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"go version exited {completed.returncode}: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    return completed.stdout.strip()


def checked_repository_sha(repository: Path, environment: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repository), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        cwd=repository,
        env=environment,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="strict",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"git rev-parse exited {completed.returncode}: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    return completed.stdout.strip()


def checked_go_environment(
    go: str,
    repository: Path,
    environment: dict[str, str],
    target: targets.Target = targets.DEFAULT,
) -> tuple[dict[str, str], Path]:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [go, "env", "-json", "GOOS", "GOARCH", "CGO_ENABLED", "GOTOOLDIR"],
        cwd=repository,
        env=environment,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="strict",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"go env exited {completed.returncode}: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    value = json.loads(completed.stdout)
    actual = {key: value.get(key) for key in ("CGO_ENABLED", "GOARCH", "GOOS")}
    if actual != target.environment:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected target Go environment: {actual!r}")
    tool_value = value.get("GOTOOLDIR")
    if not isinstance(tool_value, str) or not tool_value:
        raise RuntimeError(f"go env returned an invalid GOTOOLDIR: {tool_value!r}")
    tool_directory = Path(tool_value).resolve(strict=True)
    if not tool_directory.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError(f"Go tool directory is not a directory: {tool_directory}")
    return actual, tool_directory


def require_tracked_worktree_clean(
    repository: Path, environment: dict[str, str], label: str
) -> None:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repository), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=no"],
        cwd=repository,
        env=environment,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="strict",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        check=False,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} exited {completed.returncode}: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
    if completed.stdout.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}: tracked worktree modifications detected")


def direct_test_environment(
    environment: dict[str, str], package_directory: Path, go_tool_directory: Path
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not package_directory.is_absolute() or not go_tool_directory.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("direct test environment requires absolute package and Go tool directories")
    result = dict(environment)
    result["PWD"] = str(package_directory)
    existing_path = result.get("PATH", "")
    result["PATH"] = str(go_tool_directory) + (os.pathsep + existing_path if existing_path else "")
    return result


def ensure_executable(binary: Path, target: targets.Target) -> bool:
    """Restore the owner execute bit that artifact transport drops on POSIX targets.

    actions/upload-artifact stores files in a ZIP without POSIX modes, so a
    downloaded test binary arrives non-executable. The mode is not part of the
    binary's identity: the caller has already matched its SHA-256 to the plan,
    so setting the bit changes nothing that was verified.
    """
    if not target.posix or os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
        return False
    binary.chmod(binary.stat().st_mode | 0o500)
    if not os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot make the compiled test binary executable: {binary.name}")
    return True


def shard_command_arguments(
    package: str,
    binary: Path,
    timeout: str,
    run_regex: str,
    test_parallel: int | None,
) -> list[str]:
    arguments = [
        "tool",
        "test2json",
        "-t",
        "-p",
        package,
        str(binary),
        "-test.paniconexit0",
        f"-test.timeout={timeout}",
        f"-test.run={run_regex}",
        "-test.shuffle=off",
    ]
    if test_parallel is not None:
        arguments.append(f"-test.parallel={test_parallel}")
    arguments.append("-test.v=test2json")
    return arguments


def start_heartbeat(
    prefix: str, detail: str, started: float, interval: float
) -> tuple[threading.Event, threading.Thread]:
    """Print a liveness line to the runner console until the returned event is set."""
    stop = threading.Event()
    stream = sys.stderr

    def beat() -> None:
        while not stop.wait(interval):
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"{prefix} heartbeat {detail} elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s", file=stream, flush=True)

    thread = threading.Thread(target=beat, name="run-shard-heartbeat", daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return stop, thread


def stop_heartbeat(stop: threading.Event, thread: threading.Thread, timeout: float = 1.0) -> bool:
    """Do not let a daemon blocked on console output hold up an assignment or exception."""
    stop.set()
    thread.join(timeout=timeout)
    return not thread.is_alive()


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--shard-index", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-repository-sha", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--go-command", default="go")
    parser.add_argument("--target", default=targets.DEFAULT.name, choices=sorted(targets.TARGETS))
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def run(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    metadata: dict[str, Any],
    heartbeat_interval: float = HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
) -> int:
    target = targets.resolve(getattr(args, "target", targets.DEFAULT.name))
    if sys.platform != target.host_platform:
        raise RuntimeError(f"run_shard.py must run on native {target.host_label}")
    repository = args.repository.resolve(strict=True)
    bundle = args.bundle.resolve(strict=True)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plan_path = bundle / "plan.json"
    plan = read_json(plan_path)
    if not isinstance(plan, dict) or plan.get("schema") != PLAN_SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("unexpected or missing shard plan schema")
    if plan.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment:
        raise ValueError(f"shard plan target is not exactly {target.description}")
    if not isinstance(args.shard_index, int) or not 0 <= args.shard_index < plan.get("shardCount", -1):
        raise ValueError(f"shard index {args.shard_index} is outside the plan")
    shards = [item for item in plan.get("shards", []) if item.get("index") == args.shard_index]
    if len(shards) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"plan does not contain exactly one shard {args.shard_index}")
    shard = shards[0]
    assignments = shard.get("assignments")
    if not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments:
        raise ValueError(f"shard {args.shard_index} has no assignments")
    settings = plan.get("settings")
    if not isinstance(settings, dict) or settings.get("shuffle") != "off":
        raise ValueError("plan does not preserve shuffle=off semantics")
    timeout = settings.get("timeout")
    command_limit = settings.get("commandLineLimit")
    if not isinstance(timeout, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*(?:ns|us|µs|ms|s|m|h)", timeout):
        raise ValueError("plan has an invalid timeout")
    if not target.valid_command_line_limit(command_limit):
        raise ValueError(f"plan has an invalid {target.host_label} command-line limit")

    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update(target.environment)
    go_max_procs = settings.get("goMaxProcs")
    if go_max_procs is not None:
        if not isinstance(go_max_procs, int) or isinstance(go_max_procs, bool) or go_max_procs <= 0:
            raise ValueError("plan has invalid goMaxProcs")
        environment["GOMAXPROCS"] = str(go_max_procs)
    go = shutil.which(args.go_command, path=environment.get("PATH"))
    if go is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot resolve Go command {args.go_command!r}")
    go = str(Path(go).resolve(strict=True))
    repository_sha = checked_repository_sha(repository, environment)
    if repository_sha != args.expected_repository_sha or repository_sha != plan.get("repositorySha"):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"repository SHA mismatch: checkout={repository_sha!r}, expected={args.expected_repository_sha!r}, plan={plan.get('repositorySha')!r}"
        )
    go_version = checked_go_version(go, repository, environment)
    if go_version != plan.get("goVersion"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Go toolchain mismatch: runner={go_version!r}, plan={plan.get('goVersion')!r}")
    target_environment, go_tool_directory = checked_go_environment(
        go, repository, environment, target
    )
    if target_environment != plan.get("targetEnvironment"):
        raise RuntimeError("runner target Go environment differs from the plan")
    require_tracked_worktree_clean(repository, environment, "tracked worktree precondition")

    metadata.update(
        {
            "repositorySha": repository_sha,
            "goVersion": go_version,
            "targetEnvironment": target_environment,
            "goToolDirectory": str(go_tool_directory),
            "trackedWorktreeCleanBefore": True,
            "planSha256": sha256_file(plan_path),
            "shardIndex": args.shard_index,
            "shardCount": plan["shardCount"],
            "commandLineLimit": command_limit,
            "timeout": timeout,
            "shuffle": "off",
            "testParallel": settings.get("testParallel"),
            "goMaxProcs": go_max_procs,
        }
    )
    combined_events = output / "shard-events.jsonl"
    combined_events.write_bytes(b"")
    final_exit = 0
    try:
        clean = subprocess.run(
            [go, "clean", "-testcache"],
            cwd=repository,
            env=environment,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            check=False,
        )
        (output / "clean-testcache.stdout.log").write_bytes(clean.stdout)
        (output / "clean-testcache.stderr.log").write_bytes(clean.stderr)
        metadata["cleanTestCacheExitCode"] = clean.returncode
        if clean.returncode != 0:
            return clean.returncode

        for position, assignment in enumerate(assignments):
            package = assignment.get("importPath")
            binary_name = assignment.get("binaryName")
            expected_binary_hash = assignment.get("binarySha256")
            run_regex = assignment.get("runRegex")
            roots = assignment.get("roots")
            if not isinstance(package, str) or not package:
                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has no import path")
            if (
                not isinstance(binary_name, str)
                or Path(binary_name).name != binary_name
                or "/" in binary_name
                or "\\" in binary_name
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has unsafe binary name")
            if not isinstance(expected_binary_hash, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_binary_hash):
                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has invalid binary hash")
            if not isinstance(run_regex, str) or not run_regex.startswith("^") or not run_regex.endswith("$"):
                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has invalid run regex")
            if not isinstance(roots, list) or not roots:
                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has no runnable roots")
            package_directory = safe_repository_directory(
                repository, assignment.get("packageDirectoryRelative")
            )
            binary = (bundle / "binaries" / binary_name).resolve(strict=True)
            try:
                binary.relative_to((bundle / "binaries").resolve(strict=True))
            except ValueError as error:
                raise ValueError(f"binary escaped bundle: {binary}") from error
            actual_binary_hash = sha256_file(binary)
            if actual_binary_hash != expected_binary_hash:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"binary hash mismatch for {package}: {actual_binary_hash} != {expected_binary_hash}"
                )

            test_parallel = settings.get("testParallel")
            if test_parallel is not None and (
                not isinstance(test_parallel, int)
                or isinstance(test_parallel, bool)
                or test_parallel <= 0
            ):
                raise ValueError("plan has invalid testParallel")
            command_arguments = shard_command_arguments(
                package, binary, timeout, run_regex, test_parallel
            )
            command_units = target.command_line_cost(go, command_arguments)
            if command_units > command_limit:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"serialized {target.host_label} command line for {package} is {command_units} {target.command_line_unit}, above {command_limit}; refusing implicit batching"
                )

            stem = f"{position:02d}-{re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '_', package)}"
            stdout_path = output / f"{stem}.jsonl"
            stderr_path = output / f"{stem}.stderr.log"
            direct_environment = direct_test_environment(
                environment, package_directory, go_tool_directory
            )
            argument_area = targets.checked_argument_area(
                target, [go, *command_arguments], direct_environment, f"launch of {package}"
            )
            executable_bit_restored = ensure_executable(binary, target)
            prefix = f"shard {args.shard_index} assignment {position + 1}/{len(assignments)}"
            detail = f"package={json.dumps(package)} roots={len(roots)}"
            print(f"{prefix} start {detail}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
            started = time.monotonic()
            with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout, stderr_path.open("wb") as stderr:
                heartbeat_stop, heartbeat = start_heartbeat(
                    prefix, detail, started, heartbeat_interval
                )
                failure = None
                try:
                    completed = subprocess.run(
                        [go, *command_arguments],
                        cwd=package_directory,
                        env=direct_environment,
                        stdout=stdout,
                        stderr=stderr,
                        check=False,
                    )
                except BaseException as error:
                    # Report only the class: the message can carry argv or paths.
                    failure = type(error).__name__
                    raise
                finally:
                    duration = time.monotonic() - started
                    heartbeat_stopped = stop_heartbeat(heartbeat_stop, heartbeat)
                    if failure is not None and heartbeat_stopped:
                        # The heartbeat is joined, so this line is terminal.
                        print(
                            f"{prefix} end {detail} elapsed={duration:.3f}s "
                            f"exit=exception:{failure}",
                            file=sys.stderr,
                            flush=True,
                        )
            if heartbeat_stopped:
                print(
                    f"{prefix} end {detail} elapsed={duration:.3f}s exit={completed.returncode}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
            content = stdout_path.read_bytes()
            with combined_events.open("ab") as combined:
                combined.write(content)
                if content and not content.endswith(b"\n"):
                    combined.write(b"\n")
            invocation = {
                "package": package,
                "binaryName": binary_name,
                "binarySha256": actual_binary_hash,
                "rootCount": len(roots),
                target.command_line_metric: command_units,
                "durationSeconds": round(duration, 6),
                "exitCode": completed.returncode,
                "paniconexit0": "-test.paniconexit0" in command_arguments,
                "workingDirectoryRelative": assignment.get("packageDirectoryRelative"),
                "pwdMatchesPackageDirectory": direct_environment.get("PWD")
                == str(package_directory),
                "goToolDirectoryPrependedToPath": direct_environment.get("PATH", "").split(
                    os.pathsep, 1
                )[0]
                == str(go_tool_directory),
            }
            if target.posix:
                invocation.update(argument_area)
                invocation["executableBitRestored"] = executable_bit_restored
            metadata["invocations"].append(invocation)
            write_json(output / "shard-metadata.json", metadata)
            if completed.returncode != 0 and final_exit == 0:
                final_exit = completed.returncode
        return final_exit
    finally:
        require_tracked_worktree_clean(repository, environment, "tracked worktree postcondition")
        metadata["trackedWorktreeCleanAfter"] = True
        repository_sha_after = checked_repository_sha(repository, environment)
        metadata["repositoryShaAfter"] = repository_sha_after
        if repository_sha_after != repository_sha:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"repository SHA changed during shard execution: {repository_sha!r} -> {repository_sha_after!r}"
            )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema": RUN_SCHEMA,
        "exitCode": None,
        "errors": [],
        "invocations": [],
        "cleanTestCacheExitCode": None,
        "trackedWorktreeCleanBefore": None,
        "trackedWorktreeCleanAfter": None,
        "repositoryShaAfter": None,
    }
    try:
        exit_code = run(args, metadata)
    except Exception as error:
        metadata["errors"].append(str(error))
        exit_code = 2
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
    metadata["exitCode"] = exit_code
    write_json(output / "shard-metadata.json", metadata)
    return exit_code

508	    def placed(index: int, item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, list[float]]:

510	        before = process_seconds(serial, parallel, longest, parallelism)
511	        if item["parallel"]:
512	            parallel += item["weightSeconds"]
513	            longest = max(longest, item["weightSeconds"])
514	        else:
515	            serial += item["weightSeconds"]
516	        after = process_seconds(serial, parallel, longest, parallelism)
517	        return totals[index] - before + after, [serial, parallel, longest]
518	
519	    for item in work:
520	        destination = min(
521	            range(shard_count),
522	            key=lambda index: (placed(index, item)[0], len(bins[index]), index),
523	        )
524	        totals[destination], processes[destination][item["importPath"]] = placed(destination, item)
525	        bins[destination].append(item)

527	    shards: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
528	    for index, roots in enumerate(bins):

530	        for root in roots:
531	            by_package[root["importPath"]].append(root)
532	        assignments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
533	        for package in sorted(by_package):

535	            assignments.append(

558	                "rootCount": len(roots),
559	                "assignments": assignments,

563	    unused = sorted(f"{package}::{name}" for package, name in set(weights) - used_weight_keys)
564	    packages = [

38	def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
39	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
40	    with path.open("rb") as handle:
41	        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
42	            digest.update(chunk)
43	    return digest.hexdigest()

46	def decode_json_stream(value: str, label: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
47	    decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
48	    position = 0
49	    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
50	    while True:
51	        match = re.search(r"\S", value[position:])
52	        if match is None:
53	            break
54	        position += match.start()
55	        try:
56	            item, position = decoder.raw_decode(value, position)
57	        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
58	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: invalid concatenated JSON at offset {position}: {error}") from error
59	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
60	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream item is not an object")
61	        result.append(item)
62	    if not result:
63	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: JSON stream is empty")
64	    return result

67	def run_command(
68	    arguments: list[str],
69	    *,
70	    cwd: Path,
71	    environment: dict[str, str],
72	    stdout_path: Path | None = None,
73	    stderr_path: Path | None = None,
74	    stdin_text: str | None = None,
75	) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], float]:
76	    started = time.monotonic()
77	    completed = subprocess.run(
78	        arguments,
79	        cwd=cwd,
80	        env=environment,
81	        text=True,
82	        encoding="utf-8",
83	        errors="strict",
84	        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
85	        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
86	        input=stdin_text,
87	        check=False,
88	    )
89	    duration = time.monotonic() - started
90	    if stdout_path is not None:
91	        write_text(stdout_path, completed.stdout)
92	    if stderr_path is not None:
93	        write_text(stderr_path, completed.stderr)
94	    return completed, duration

127	def repository_relative_directory(repository: Path, directory: str, label: str) -> str:
128	    resolved = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True)
129	    try:
130	        relative = resolved.relative_to(repository)
131	    except ValueError as error:
132	        raise ValueError(f"{label} directory is outside the repository: {resolved}") from error
133	    if not relative.parts:
134	        return "."
135	    if ".." in relative.parts:
136	        raise ValueError(f"{label} directory is unsafe: {relative}")
137	    return relative.as_posix()

140	def classify_listing(lines: Iterable[str], label: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]:
141	    roots: list[dict[str, str]] = []
142	    benchmarks: list[str] = []
143	    unexpected: list[str] = []
144	    seen: set[str] = set()
145	    for raw in lines:
146	        name = raw.strip()
147	        if not name:
148	            continue
149	        if name in seen:
150	            raise ValueError(f"{label}: duplicate -test.list output {name!r}")
151	        seen.add(name)
152	        if name == "TestMain":
153	            unexpected.append(name)
154	        elif name.startswith("Benchmark"):
155	            benchmarks.append(name)
156	        else:
157	            kind = next((prefix for prefix in ROOT_PREFIXES if name.startswith(prefix)), None)
158	            if kind is None or any(character.isspace() for character in name):
159	                unexpected.append(name)
160	            else:
161	                roots.append({"name": name, "kind": kind})
162	    if unexpected:
163	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: unexpected -test.list output: {unexpected[:20]!r}")
164	    if not roots:
165	        raise ValueError(f"{label}: compiled binary listed no default-runnable roots")
166	    return sorted(roots, key=lambda item: item["name"]), sorted(benchmarks)

54	def safe_repository_directory(repository: Path, relative: Any) -> Path:
55	    if not isinstance(relative, str) or not relative or "\\" in relative:
56	        raise ValueError(f"unsafe package directory {relative!r}")
57	    value = PurePosixPath(relative)
58	    if value.is_absolute() or ".." in value.parts:
59	        raise ValueError(f"unsafe package directory {relative!r}")
60	    resolved = repository.joinpath(*value.parts).resolve(strict=True)
61	    try:
62	        resolved.relative_to(repository)
63	    except ValueError as error:
64	        raise ValueError(f"package directory escaped repository: {resolved}") from error
65	    if not resolved.is_dir():
66	        raise ValueError(f"package directory is not a directory: {resolved}")
67	    return resolved

105	    go: str,
106	    repository: Path,
107	    environment: dict[str, str],
108	    target: targets.Target = targets.DEFAULT,
109	) -> tuple[dict[str, str], Path]:
110	    completed = subprocess.run(

123	    value = json.loads(completed.stdout)

168	def ensure_executable(binary: Path, target: targets.Target) -> bool:
169	    """Restore the owner execute bit that artifact transport drops on POSIX targets.
170	
171	    actions/upload-artifact stores files in a ZIP without POSIX modes, so a
172	    downloaded test binary arrives non-executable. The mode is not part of the
173	    binary's identity: the caller has already matched its SHA-256 to the plan,
174	    so setting the bit changes nothing that was verified.
175	    """
176	    if not target.posix or os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
177	        return False
178	    binary.chmod(binary.stat().st_mode | 0o500)
179	    if not os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
180	        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot make the compiled test binary executable: {binary.name}")
181	    return True

209	def start_heartbeat(
210	    prefix: str, detail: str, started: float, interval: float
211	) -> tuple[threading.Event, threading.Thread]:
212	    """Print a liveness line to the runner console until the returned event is set."""
213	    stop = threading.Event()
214	    stream = sys.stderr
215	
216	    def beat() -> None:
217	        while not stop.wait(interval):
218	            elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
219	            print(f"{prefix} heartbeat {detail} elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s", file=stream, flush=True)
220	
221	    thread = threading.Thread(target=beat, name="run-shard-heartbeat", daemon=True)
222	    thread.start()
223	    return stop, thread
224

226	def stop_heartbeat(stop: threading.Event, thread: threading.Thread, timeout: float = 1.0) -> bool:
227	    """Do not let a daemon blocked on console output hold up an assignment or exception."""
228	    stop.set()
229	    thread.join(timeout=timeout)
230	    return not thread.is_alive()

245	def run(
246	    args: argparse.Namespace,
247	    metadata: dict[str, Any],
248	    heartbeat_interval: float = HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
249	) -> int:
250	    target = targets.resolve(getattr(args, "target", targets.DEFAULT.name))
251	    if sys.platform != target.host_platform:
252	        raise RuntimeError(f"run_shard.py must run on native {target.host_label}")
253	    repository = args.repository.resolve(strict=True)
254	    bundle = args.bundle.resolve(strict=True)
255	    output = args.output.resolve()
256	    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
257	    plan_path = bundle / "plan.json"
258	    plan = read_json(plan_path)
259	    if not isinstance(plan, dict) or plan.get("schema") != PLAN_SCHEMA:
260	        raise ValueError("unexpected or missing shard plan schema")
261	    if plan.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment:
262	        raise ValueError(f"shard plan target is not exactly {target.description}")
263	    if not isinstance(args.shard_index, int) or not 0 <= args.shard_index < plan.get("shardCount", -1):
264	        raise ValueError(f"shard index {args.shard_index} is outside the plan")
265	    shards = [item for item in plan.get("shards", []) if item.get("index") == args.shard_index]
266	    if len(shards) != 1:
267	        raise ValueError(f"plan does not contain exactly one shard {args.shard_index}")
268	    shard = shards[0]
269	    assignments = shard.get("assignments")
270	    if not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments:
271	        raise ValueError(f"shard {args.shard_index} has no assignments")
272	    settings = plan.get("settings")
273	    if not isinstance(settings, dict) or settings.get("shuffle") != "off":
274	        raise ValueError("plan does not preserve shuffle=off semantics")
275	    timeout = settings.get("timeout")
276	    command_limit = settings.get("commandLineLimit")
277	    if not isinstance(timeout, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*(?:ns|us|µs|ms|s|m|h)", timeout):
278	        raise ValueError("plan has an invalid timeout")
279	    if not target.valid_command_line_limit(command_limit):
280	        raise ValueError(f"plan has an invalid {target.host_label} command-line limit")
281	
282	    environment = dict(os.environ)
283	    environment.update(target.environment)
284	    go_max_procs = settings.get("goMaxProcs")
285	    if go_max_procs is not None:
286	        if not isinstance(go_max_procs, int) or isinstance(go_max_procs, bool) or go_max_procs <= 0:
287	            raise ValueError("plan has invalid goMaxProcs")
288	        environment["GOMAXPROCS"] = str(go_max_procs)
289	    go = shutil.which(args.go_command, path=environment.get("PATH"))
290	    if go is None:
291	        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot resolve Go command {args.go_command!r}")
292	    go = str(Path(go).resolve(strict=True))
293	    repository_sha = checked_repository_sha(repository, environment)
294	    if repository_sha != args.expected_repository_sha or repository_sha != plan.get("repositorySha"):
295	        raise RuntimeError(
296	            f"repository SHA mismatch: checkout={repository_sha!r}, expected={args.expected_repository_sha!r}, plan={plan.get('repositorySha')!r}"
297	        )
298	    go_version = checked_go_version(go, repository, environment)
299	    if go_version != plan.get("goVersion"):
300	        raise RuntimeError(f"Go toolchain mismatch: runner={go_version!r}, plan={plan.get('goVersion')!r}")
301	    target_environment, go_tool_directory = checked_go_environment(
302	        go, repository, environment, target
303	    )
304	    if target_environment != plan.get("targetEnvironment"):
305	        raise RuntimeError("runner target Go environment differs from the plan")
306	    require_tracked_worktree_clean(repository, environment, "tracked worktree precondition")
307	
308	    metadata.update(
309	        {
310	            "repositorySha": repository_sha,
311	            "goVersion": go_version,
312	            "targetEnvironment": target_environment,
313	            "goToolDirectory": str(go_tool_directory),
314	            "trackedWorktreeCleanBefore": True,
315	            "planSha256": sha256_file(plan_path),
316	            "shardIndex": args.shard_index,
317	            "shardCount": plan["shardCount"],
318	            "commandLineLimit": command_limit,
319	            "timeout": timeout,
320	            "shuffle": "off",
321	            "testParallel": settings.get("testParallel"),
322	            "goMaxProcs": go_max_procs,
323	        }
324	    )
325	    combined_events = output / "shard-events.jsonl"
326	    combined_events.write_bytes(b"")
327	    final_exit = 0
328	    try:
329	        clean = subprocess.run(
330	            [go, "clean", "-testcache"],
331	            cwd=repository,
332	            env=environment,
333	            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
334	            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
335	            check=False,
336	        )
337	        (output / "clean-testcache.stdout.log").write_bytes(clean.stdout)
338	        (output / "clean-testcache.stderr.log").write_bytes(clean.stderr)
339	        metadata["cleanTestCacheExitCode"] = clean.returncode
340	        if clean.returncode != 0:
341	            return clean.returncode
342	
343	        for position, assignment in enumerate(assignments):
344	            package = assignment.get("importPath")
345	            binary_name = assignment.get("binaryName")
346	            expected_binary_hash = assignment.get("binarySha256")
347	            run_regex = assignment.get("runRegex")
348	            roots = assignment.get("roots")
349	            if not isinstance(package, str) or not package:
350	                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has no import path")
351	            if (
352	                not isinstance(binary_name, str)
353	                or Path(binary_name).name != binary_name
354	                or "/" in binary_name
355	                or "\\" in binary_name
356	            ):
357	                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has unsafe binary name")
358	            if not isinstance(expected_binary_hash, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_binary_hash):
359	                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has invalid binary hash")
360	            if not isinstance(run_regex, str) or not run_regex.startswith("^") or not run_regex.endswith("$"):
361	                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has invalid run regex")
362	            if not isinstance(roots, list) or not roots:
363	                raise ValueError(f"assignment {position} has no runnable roots")
364	            package_directory = safe_repository_directory(
365	                repository, assignment.get("packageDirectoryRelative")
366	            )
367	            binary = (bundle / "binaries" / binary_name).resolve(strict=True)
368	            try:
369	                binary.relative_to((bundle / "binaries").resolve(strict=True))
370	            except ValueError as error:
371	                raise ValueError(f"binary escaped bundle: {binary}") from error
372	            actual_binary_hash = sha256_file(binary)
373	            if actual_binary_hash != expected_binary_hash:
374	                raise RuntimeError(
375	                    f"binary hash mismatch for {package}: {actual_binary_hash} != {expected_binary_hash}"
376	                )
377	
378	            test_parallel = settings.get("testParallel")
379	            if test_parallel is not None and (
380	                not isinstance(test_parallel, int)
381	                or isinstance(test_parallel, bool)
382	                or test_parallel <= 0
383	            ):
384	                raise ValueError("plan has invalid testParallel")
385	            command_arguments = shard_command_arguments(
386	                package, binary, timeout, run_regex, test_parallel
387	            )
388	            command_units = target.command_line_cost(go, command_arguments)
389	            if command_units > command_limit:
390	                raise RuntimeError(
391	                    f"serialized {target.host_label} command line for {package} is {command_units} {target.command_line_unit}, above {command_limit}; refusing implicit batching"
392	                )
393	
394	            stem = f"{position:02d}-{re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '_', package)}"
395	            stdout_path = output / f"{stem}.jsonl"
396	            stderr_path = output / f"{stem}.stderr.log"
397	            direct_environment = direct_test_environment(
398	                environment, package_directory, go_tool_directory
399	            )
400	            argument_area = targets.checked_argument_area(
401	                target, [go, *command_arguments], direct_environment, f"launch of {package}"
402	            )
403	            executable_bit_restored = ensure_executable(binary, target)
404	            prefix = f"shard {args.shard_index} assignment {position + 1}/{len(assignments)}"
405	            detail = f"package={json.dumps(package)} roots={len(roots)}"
406	            print(f"{prefix} start {detail}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
407	            started = time.monotonic()
408	            with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout, stderr_path.open("wb") as stderr:
409	                heartbeat_stop, heartbeat = start_heartbeat(
410	                    prefix, detail, started, heartbeat_interval
411	                )
412	                failure = None
413	                try:
414	                    completed = subprocess.run(
415	                        [go, *command_arguments],
416	                        cwd=package_directory,
417	                        env=direct_environment,
418	                        stdout=stdout,
419	                        stderr=stderr,
420	                        check=False,
421	                    )
422	                except BaseException as error:
423	                    # Report only the class: the message can carry argv or paths.
424	                    failure = type(error).__name__
425	                    raise
426	                finally:
427	                    duration = time.monotonic() - started
428	                    heartbeat_stopped = stop_heartbeat(heartbeat_stop, heartbeat)
429	                    if failure is not None and heartbeat_stopped:
430	                        # The heartbeat is joined, so this line is terminal.
431	                        print(
432	                            f"{prefix} end {detail} elapsed={duration:.3f}s "
433	                            f"exit=exception:{failure}",
434	                            file=sys.stderr,
435	                            flush=True,
436	                        )
437	            if heartbeat_stopped:
438	                print(
439	                    f"{prefix} end {detail} elapsed={duration:.3f}s exit={completed.returncode}",
440	                    file=sys.stderr,
441	                    flush=True,
442	                )
443	            content = stdout_path.read_bytes()
444	            with combined_events.open("ab") as combined:
445	                combined.write(content)
446	                if content and not content.endswith(b"\n"):
447	                    combined.write(b"\n")
448	            invocation = {
449	                "package": package,
450	                "binaryName": binary_name,
451	                "binarySha256": actual_binary_hash,
452	                "rootCount": len(roots),
453	                target.command_line_metric: command_units,
454	                "durationSeconds": round(duration, 6),
455	                "exitCode": completed.returncode,
456	                "paniconexit0": "-test.paniconexit0" in command_arguments,
457	                "workingDirectoryRelative": assignment.get("packageDirectoryRelative"),
458	                "pwdMatchesPackageDirectory": direct_environment.get("PWD")
459	                == str(package_directory),
460	                "goToolDirectoryPrependedToPath": direct_environment.get("PATH", "").split(
461	                    os.pathsep, 1
462	                )[0]
463	                == str(go_tool_directory),
464	            }
465	            if target.posix:
466	                invocation.update(argument_area)
467	                invocation["executableBitRestored"] = executable_bit_restored
468	            metadata["invocations"].append(invocation)
469	            write_json(output / "shard-metadata.json", metadata)
470	            if completed.returncode != 0 and final_exit == 0:
471	                final_exit = completed.returncode
472	        return final_exit
473	    finally:
474	        require_tracked_worktree_clean(repository, environment, "tracked worktree postcondition")
475	        metadata["trackedWorktreeCleanAfter"] = True
476	        repository_sha_after = checked_repository_sha(repository, environment)
477	        metadata["repositoryShaAfter"] = repository_sha_after
478	        if repository_sha_after != repository_sha:
479	            raise RuntimeError(
480	                f"repository SHA changed during shard execution: {repository_sha!r} -> {repository_sha_after!r}"
481	            )

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Regenerate a target's historical weights from downloaded CI shard evidence.
3	
4	Weights only balance shards; they never decide what runs. This reads the
5	`*-test-shard-N` artifacts of one green run (each holds `shard-metadata.json`
6	and `shard-events.jsonl`), takes every top-level root's terminal elapsed time
7	as measured on the real runner, and writes the roots at or above a threshold.
8	Roots below it keep the settings' default weight.
9	
10	The planner balances estimated wall time, and a root that calls `t.Parallel()`
11	overlaps the other parallel roots of its process. The evidence says which
12	roots paused for `t.Parallel()` and how long each test process really took, so
13	this also records each root's `parallel` flag and the `parallelism` that best
14	explains the run under the planner's own model (`plan_shards.process_seconds`):
15	
16	    process wall = serial elapsed + max(longest parallel root,
17	                                        parallel elapsed / parallelism)
18	"""
19	
20	from __future__ import annotations
21	
22	import argparse
23	import json
24	import math
25	import sys
26	from pathlib import Path
27	from typing import Any
28	
29	import plan_shards
30	import targets
31	
32	
33	SHARD_RUN_SCHEMA = "entire-graph.windows-ci.shard-run.v1"
34	TERMINAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({"pass", "fail", "skip"})
35	
36	
37	def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
38	    return plan_shards.read_json(path)
39	
40	
41	class Evidence:
42	    """One complete run: per-root elapsed, which roots are parallel, and each test process."""
43	
44	    def __init__(self) -> None:
45	        self.elapsed: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
46	        self.parallel: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
47	        # (shard index, package) -> measured wall seconds of that test process.
48	        self.processes: dict[tuple[Any, str], float] = {}
49	        self.shard_of: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
50	        self.commit = ""
51	        self.shard_count = 0
52	
53	    def parallelism(self) -> float:
54	        """The overlap of parallel roots that best explains the measured process times.
55	
56	        Searched on a fixed grid so the result is deterministic; 1.0 when the
57	        evidence holds no parallel root.
58	        """
59	        shapes: dict[tuple[Any, str], list[float]] = {key: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] for key in self.processes}
60	        for key, seconds in self.elapsed.items():
61	            shape = shapes.get((self.shard_of[key], key[0]))
62	            if shape is None:
63	                continue
64	            if key in self.parallel:
65	                shape[1] += seconds
66	                shape[2] = max(shape[2], seconds)
67	            else:
68	                shape[0] += seconds
69	        if not any(shape[1] > 0 for shape in shapes.values()):
70	            return 1.0
71	        best = (math.inf, 1.0)
72	        for step in range(20, 641):
73	            candidate = step / 20
74	            error = sum(
75	                abs(self.processes[key] - plan_shards.process_seconds(*shape, candidate))
76	                for key, shape in shapes.items()
77	            )
78	            if error < best[0]:
79	                best = (error, candidate)
80	        return best[1]
81	
82	
83	def collect(evidence: Path, target: targets.Target) -> Evidence:
84	    """Read one complete, successful run of one target, or raise ValueError."""
85	    result = Evidence()
86	    metadata_paths = sorted(evidence.rglob("shard-metadata.json"))
87	    if not metadata_paths:
88	        raise ValueError(f"{evidence}: no shard-metadata.json found")
89	    elapsed = result.elapsed
90	    commits: set[Any] = set()
91	    indexes: list[Any] = []
92	    shard_counts: set[Any] = set()
93	    for metadata_path in metadata_paths:
94	        metadata = read_json(metadata_path)
95	        if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or metadata.get("schema") != SHARD_RUN_SCHEMA:
96	            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: unexpected shard metadata schema")
97	        if metadata.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment:
98	            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: evidence is not {target.description}")
99	        if metadata.get("exitCode") != 0 or metadata.get("errors") != []:
100	            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: shard did not succeed; refusing to learn from it")
101	        commits.add(metadata.get("repositorySha"))
102	        indexes.append(metadata.get("shardIndex"))
103	        shard_counts.add(metadata.get("shardCount"))
104	        invocations = metadata.get("invocations")
105	        if not isinstance(invocations, list) or not invocations:
106	            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: shard records no test process")
107	        for invocation in invocations:
108	            seconds = invocation.get("durationSeconds") if isinstance(invocation, dict) else None
109	            package_name = invocation.get("package") if isinstance(invocation, dict) else None
110	            if (
111	                not isinstance(seconds, (int, float))
112	                or isinstance(seconds, bool)
113	                or not math.isfinite(float(seconds))
114	                or float(seconds) < 0
115	                or not isinstance(package_name, str)
116	                or (metadata.get("shardIndex"), package_name) in result.processes
117	            ):
118	                raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: test process has no valid package and durationSeconds")
119	            result.processes[(metadata.get("shardIndex"), package_name)] = float(seconds)
120	        events_path = metadata_path.with_name("shard-events.jsonl")
121	        try:
122	            handle = events_path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig")
123	        except OSError as error:
124	            raise ValueError(f"cannot read {events_path}: {error}") from error
125	        with handle:
126	            for line_number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
127	                if not line.strip():
128	                    continue
129	                try:
130	                    event = json.loads(line)
131	                except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
132	                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: invalid JSON: {error}") from error
133	                if not isinstance(event, dict):
134	                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: event is not an object")
135	                test, package = event.get("Test"), event.get("Package")
136	                if not isinstance(test, str) or "/" in test or not isinstance(package, str):
137	                    continue
138	                if event.get("Action") == "pause":
139	                    # test2json reports `=== PAUSE` when a root calls t.Parallel().
140	                    result.parallel.add((package, test))
141	                    continue
142	                if event.get("Action") not in TERMINAL_ACTIONS:
143	                    continue
144	                if event["Action"] == "fail":
145	                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: failed root {package}::{test}")
146	                seconds = event.get("Elapsed", 0.0)
147	                if (
148	                    not isinstance(seconds, (int, float))
149	                    or isinstance(seconds, bool)
150	                    or not math.isfinite(float(seconds))
151	                    or float(seconds) < 0
152	                ):
153	                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: invalid Elapsed for {package}::{test}")
154	                key = (package, test)
155	                if key in elapsed:
156	                    raise ValueError(f"root {package}::{test} has more than one terminal event")
157	                elapsed[key] = float(seconds)
158	                result.shard_of[key] = metadata.get("shardIndex")
159	    if len(commits) != 1 or not isinstance(next(iter(commits)), str):
160	        raise ValueError(f"evidence spans repository commits {sorted(map(str, commits))!r}")
161	    if len(shard_counts) != 1 or not isinstance(next(iter(shard_counts)), int):
162	        raise ValueError("evidence disagrees on the shard count")
163	    shard_count = next(iter(shard_counts))
164	    if sorted(indexes, key=str) != sorted(range(shard_count), key=str):
165	        raise ValueError(f"evidence holds shard indexes {indexes!r}, want every index of {shard_count} once")
166	    if not elapsed:
167	        raise ValueError("evidence contains no top-level terminal events")
168	    result.commit = next(iter(commits))
169	    result.shard_count = shard_count
170	    return result
171	
172	
173	def render(evidence: Evidence, minimum_seconds: float, source: str) -> str:
174	    rows = sorted(
175	        (package, name, round(seconds, 2), (package, name) in evidence.parallel)
176	        for (package, name), seconds in evidence.elapsed.items()
177	        if seconds >= minimum_seconds
178	    )
179	    lines = [
180	        "{",
181	        f'  "schema": {json.dumps(plan_shards.WEIGHTS_SCHEMA)},',
182	        f'  "sourceCommit": {json.dumps(evidence.commit)},',
183	        f'  "source": {json.dumps(source, ensure_ascii=False)},',
184	        f'  "parallelism": {json.dumps(evidence.parallelism())},',
185	        '  "weights": [',
186	    ]
187	    for position, (package, name, seconds, parallel) in enumerate(rows):
188	        record: dict[str, Any] = {"package": package, "name": name, "seconds": seconds}
189	        if parallel:
190	            record["parallel"] = True
191	        row = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False)
192	        lines.append("    " + row + ("," if position < len(rows) - 1 else ""))
193	    lines += ["  ]", "}"]
194	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
195	
196	
197	def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
198	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
199	    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True, help="directory of downloaded shard artifacts")
200	    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True, help="historical-weights file to write")
201	    parser.add_argument("--target", default=targets.DEFAULT.name, choices=sorted(targets.TARGETS))
202	    parser.add_argument("--minimum-seconds", type=float, default=0.5)
203	    parser.add_argument("--run", default=None, help="CI run identifier to record in the source note")
204	    return parser.parse_args(argv)
205	
206	
207	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
208	    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
209	    try:
210	        target = targets.resolve(args.target)
211	        if not math.isfinite(args.minimum_seconds) or args.minimum_seconds < 0:
212	            raise ValueError("--minimum-seconds must be finite and non-negative")
213	        evidence = collect(args.evidence.resolve(strict=True), target)
214	        weights = evidence.elapsed
215	        run = f" of CI run {args.run}" if args.run else ""
216	        source = (
217	            f"Top-level terminal elapsed from the {evidence.shard_count} {target.name} shard evidence"
218	            f" artifacts{run}; roots below {args.minimum_seconds:g} seconds intentionally use the"
219	            " configured default."
220	        )
221	        text = render(evidence, args.minimum_seconds, source)
222	        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
223	        args.output.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
224	        plan_shards.load_weights(args.output)
225	    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
226	        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
227	        return 2
228	    kept = [seconds for seconds in weights.values() if seconds >= args.minimum_seconds]
229	    rest = [seconds for seconds in weights.values() if seconds < args.minimum_seconds]
230	    print(f"wrote {len(kept)} of {len(weights)} roots from commit {evidence.commit} to {args.output}")
231	    print(f"fitted t.Parallel parallelism: {evidence.parallelism():.2f}")
232	    if rest:
233	        print(f"mean weight of the {len(rest)} unrecorded roots: {sum(rest) / len(rest):.3f} s")
234	    return 0
235	
236	
237	if __name__ == "__main__":
238	    raise SystemExit(main())

The planner balances estimated wall time, and a root that calls `t.Parallel()`
overlaps the other parallel roots of its process. The evidence says which
roots paused for `t.Parallel()` and how long each test process really took, so
this also records each root's `parallel` flag and the `parallelism` that best
explains the run under the planner's own model (`plan_shards.process_seconds`):

    process wall = serial elapsed + max(longest parallel root,
                                        parallel elapsed / parallelism)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import plan_shards
import targets


SHARD_RUN_SCHEMA = "entire-graph.windows-ci.shard-run.v1"
TERMINAL_ACTIONS = frozenset({"pass", "fail", "skip"})


def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    return plan_shards.read_json(path)


class Evidence:
    """One complete run: per-root elapsed, which roots are parallel, and each test process."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.elapsed: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
        self.parallel: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        # (shard index, package) -> measured wall seconds of that test process.
        self.processes: dict[tuple[Any, str], float] = {}
        self.shard_of: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
        self.commit = ""
        self.shard_count = 0

    def parallelism(self) -> float:
        """The overlap of parallel roots that best explains the measured process times.

        Searched on a fixed grid so the result is deterministic; 1.0 when the
        evidence holds no parallel root.
        """
        shapes: dict[tuple[Any, str], list[float]] = {key: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] for key in self.processes}
        for key, seconds in self.elapsed.items():
            shape = shapes.get((self.shard_of[key], key[0]))
            if shape is None:
                continue
            if key in self.parallel:
                shape[1] += seconds
                shape[2] = max(shape[2], seconds)
            else:
                shape[0] += seconds
        if not any(shape[1] > 0 for shape in shapes.values()):
            return 1.0
        best = (math.inf, 1.0)
        for step in range(20, 641):
            candidate = step / 20
            error = sum(
                abs(self.processes[key] - plan_shards.process_seconds(*shape, candidate))
                for key, shape in shapes.items()
            )
            if error < best[0]:
                best = (error, candidate)
        return best[1]


def collect(evidence: Path, target: targets.Target) -> Evidence:
    """Read one complete, successful run of one target, or raise ValueError."""
    result = Evidence()
    metadata_paths = sorted(evidence.rglob("shard-metadata.json"))
    if not metadata_paths:
        raise ValueError(f"{evidence}: no shard-metadata.json found")
    elapsed = result.elapsed
    commits: set[Any] = set()
    indexes: list[Any] = []
    shard_counts: set[Any] = set()
    for metadata_path in metadata_paths:
        metadata = read_json(metadata_path)
        if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or metadata.get("schema") != SHARD_RUN_SCHEMA:
            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: unexpected shard metadata schema")
        if metadata.get("targetEnvironment") != target.environment:
            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: evidence is not {target.description}")
        if metadata.get("exitCode") != 0 or metadata.get("errors") != []:
            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: shard did not succeed; refusing to learn from it")
        commits.add(metadata.get("repositorySha"))
        indexes.append(metadata.get("shardIndex"))
        shard_counts.add(metadata.get("shardCount"))
        invocations = metadata.get("invocations")
        if not isinstance(invocations, list) or not invocations:
            raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: shard records no test process")
        for invocation in invocations:
            seconds = invocation.get("durationSeconds") if isinstance(invocation, dict) else None
            package_name = invocation.get("package") if isinstance(invocation, dict) else None
            if (
                not isinstance(seconds, (int, float))
                or isinstance(seconds, bool)
                or not math.isfinite(float(seconds))
                or float(seconds) < 0
                or not isinstance(package_name, str)
                or (metadata.get("shardIndex"), package_name) in result.processes
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"{metadata_path}: test process has no valid package and durationSeconds")
            result.processes[(metadata.get("shardIndex"), package_name)] = float(seconds)
        events_path = metadata_path.with_name("shard-events.jsonl")
        try:
            handle = events_path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        except OSError as error:
            raise ValueError(f"cannot read {events_path}: {error}") from error
        with handle:
            for line_number, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
                if not line.strip():
                    continue
                try:
                    event = json.loads(line)
                except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: invalid JSON: {error}") from error
                if not isinstance(event, dict):
                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: event is not an object")
                test, package = event.get("Test"), event.get("Package")
                if not isinstance(test, str) or "/" in test or not isinstance(package, str):
                    continue
                if event.get("Action") == "pause":
                    # test2json reports `=== PAUSE` when a root calls t.Parallel().
                    result.parallel.add((package, test))
                    continue
                if event.get("Action") not in TERMINAL_ACTIONS:
                    continue
                if event["Action"] == "fail":
                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: failed root {package}::{test}")
                seconds = event.get("Elapsed", 0.0)
                if (
                    not isinstance(seconds, (int, float))
                    or isinstance(seconds, bool)
                    or not math.isfinite(float(seconds))
                    or float(seconds) < 0
                ):
                    raise ValueError(f"{events_path}:{line_number}: invalid Elapsed for {package}::{test}")
                key = (package, test)
                if key in elapsed:
                    raise ValueError(f"root {package}::{test} has more than one terminal event")
                elapsed[key] = float(seconds)
                result.shard_of[key] = metadata.get("shardIndex")
    if len(commits) != 1 or not isinstance(next(iter(commits)), str):
        raise ValueError(f"evidence spans repository commits {sorted(map(str, commits))!r}")
    if len(shard_counts) != 1 or not isinstance(next(iter(shard_counts)), int):
        raise ValueError("evidence disagrees on the shard count")
    shard_count = next(iter(shard_counts))
    if sorted(indexes, key=str) != sorted(range(shard_count), key=str):
        raise ValueError(f"evidence holds shard indexes {indexes!r}, want every index of {shard_count} once")
    if not elapsed:
        raise ValueError("evidence contains no top-level terminal events")
    result.commit = next(iter(commits))
    result.shard_count = shard_count
    return result


def render(evidence: Evidence, minimum_seconds: float, source: str) -> str:
    rows = sorted(
        (package, name, round(seconds, 2), (package, name) in evidence.parallel)
        for (package, name), seconds in evidence.elapsed.items()
        if seconds >= minimum_seconds
    )
    lines = [
        "{",
        f'  "schema": {json.dumps(plan_shards.WEIGHTS_SCHEMA)},',
        f'  "sourceCommit": {json.dumps(evidence.commit)},',
        f'  "source": {json.dumps(source, ensure_ascii=False)},',
        f'  "parallelism": {json.dumps(evidence.parallelism())},',
        '  "weights": [',
    ]
    for position, (package, name, seconds, parallel) in enumerate(rows):
        record: dict[str, Any] = {"package": package, "name": name, "seconds": seconds}
        if parallel:
            record["parallel"] = True
        row = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False)
        lines.append("    " + row + ("," if position < len(rows) - 1 else ""))
    lines += ["  ]", "}"]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True, help="directory of downloaded shard artifacts")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True, help="historical-weights file to write")
    parser.add_argument("--target", default=targets.DEFAULT.name, choices=sorted(targets.TARGETS))
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-seconds", type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument("--run", default=None, help="CI run identifier to record in the source note")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    try:
        target = targets.resolve(args.target)
        if not math.isfinite(args.minimum_seconds) or args.minimum_seconds < 0:
            raise ValueError("--minimum-seconds must be finite and non-negative")
        evidence = collect(args.evidence.resolve(strict=True), target)
        weights = evidence.elapsed
        run = f" of CI run {args.run}" if args.run else ""
        source = (
            f"Top-level terminal elapsed from the {evidence.shard_count} {target.name} shard evidence"
            f" artifacts{run}; roots below {args.minimum_seconds:g} seconds intentionally use the"
            " configured default."
        )
        text = render(evidence, args.minimum_seconds, source)
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.output.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        plan_shards.load_weights(args.output)
    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    kept = [seconds for seconds in weights.values() if seconds >= args.minimum_seconds]
    rest = [seconds for seconds in weights.values() if seconds < args.minimum_seconds]
    print(f"wrote {len(kept)} of {len(weights)} roots from commit {evidence.commit} to {args.output}")
    print(f"fitted t.Parallel parallelism: {evidence.parallelism():.2f}")
    if rest:
        print(f"mean weight of the {len(rest)} unrecorded roots: {sum(rest) / len(rest):.3f} s")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

//go:build ignore

// inventory_testmain reads one `go list -json` package from stdin and reports
// every top-level TestMain declaration selected for that exact target. The
// declaration slice is normalized to LF before hashing so Git checkout line-
// ending policy cannot change the identity of otherwise identical Go source.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
)

const outputSchema = "entire-graph.windows-ci.testmain-inventory.v1"

type packageInput struct {
	Dir          string
	TestGoFiles  []string
	XTestGoFiles []string
}

type declaration struct {
	File                   string `json:"file"`
	NormalizedSourceSHA256 string `json:"normalizedSourceSha256"`
}

type output struct {
	Schema       string        `json:"schema"`
	Declarations []declaration `json:"declarations"`
}

func normalizedDeclarationHash(source []byte) string {
	// CRLF is the expected Windows checkout variation. Normalizing remaining
	// lone CR bytes as well gives this field one explicit, platform-independent
	// text policy instead of depending on a Git client's checkout settings.
	normalized := bytes.ReplaceAll(source, []byte("\r\n"), []byte("\n"))
	normalized = bytes.ReplaceAll(normalized, []byte("\r"), []byte("\n"))
	digest := sha256.Sum256(normalized)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func inspectFile(directory, name string) ([]declaration, error) {
	if name == "" || filepath.Base(name) != name {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsafe target-selected test file %q", name)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, name)
	source, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read target-selected test file %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	files := token.NewFileSet()
	parsed, err := parser.ParseFile(files, path, source, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse target-selected test file %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	tokenFile := files.File(parsed.Pos())
	if tokenFile == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("target-selected test file %q has no token file", name)
	}
	var result []declaration
	for _, candidate := range parsed.Decls {
		function, ok := candidate.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || function.Recv != nil || function.Name.Name != "TestMain" {
			continue
		}
		start := tokenFile.Offset(function.Pos())
		end := tokenFile.Offset(function.End())
		if start < 0 || end < start || end > len(source) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid TestMain source range in %q", name)
		}
		result = append(result, declaration{
			File:                   name,
			NormalizedSourceSHA256: normalizedDeclarationHash(source[start:end]),
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func run(reader io.Reader, writer io.Writer) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
	var input packageInput
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil {

// inventory_testmain reads one `go list -json` package from stdin and reports
// every top-level TestMain declaration selected for that exact target. The
// declaration slice is normalized to LF before hashing so Git checkout line-
// ending policy cannot change the identity of otherwise identical Go source.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
)

const outputSchema = "entire-graph.windows-ci.testmain-inventory.v1"

type packageInput struct {
	Dir          string
	TestGoFiles  []string
	XTestGoFiles []string
}

type declaration struct {
	File                   string `json:"file"`
	NormalizedSourceSHA256 string `json:"normalizedSourceSha256"`
}

type output struct {
	Schema       string        `json:"schema"`
	Declarations []declaration `json:"declarations"`
}

func normalizedDeclarationHash(source []byte) string {
	// CRLF is the expected Windows checkout variation. Normalizing remaining
	// lone CR bytes as well gives this field one explicit, platform-independent
	// text policy instead of depending on a Git client's checkout settings.
	normalized := bytes.ReplaceAll(source, []byte("\r\n"), []byte("\n"))
	normalized = bytes.ReplaceAll(normalized, []byte("\r"), []byte("\n"))
	digest := sha256.Sum256(normalized)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func inspectFile(directory, name string) ([]declaration, error) {
	if name == "" || filepath.Base(name) != name {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsafe target-selected test file %q", name)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, name)
	source, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read target-selected test file %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	files := token.NewFileSet()
	parsed, err := parser.ParseFile(files, path, source, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse target-selected test file %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	tokenFile := files.File(parsed.Pos())
	if tokenFile == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("target-selected test file %q has no token file", name)
	}
	var result []declaration
	for _, candidate := range parsed.Decls {
		function, ok := candidate.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || function.Recv != nil || function.Name.Name != "TestMain" {
			continue
		}
		start := tokenFile.Offset(function.Pos())
		end := tokenFile.Offset(function.End())
		if start < 0 || end < start || end > len(source) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid TestMain source range in %q", name)
		}
		result = append(result, declaration{
			File:                   name,
			NormalizedSourceSHA256: normalizedDeclarationHash(source[start:end]),
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

	decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)

		return fmt.Errorf("decode go-list package: %w", err)
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {

		}

		return fmt.Errorf("go-list package directory is not absolute: %q", input.Dir)

	declarations := make([]declaration, 0)

		}

		if err != nil {
			return err

		if declarations[i].File != declarations[j].File {
			return declarations[i].File < declarations[j].File
		}
		return declarations[i].NormalizedSourceSHA256 < declarations[j].NormalizedSourceSHA256
	})
	return json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(output{
		Schema:       outputSchema,
		Declarations: declarations,
	})
